name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Reserves a box at a fixed ratio so media cannot shift the layout.
docs: ## When to use - An image, video, or embed whose intrinsic size is unknown until it loads. - A thumbnail grid that must not reflow as the images arrive. - A placeholder that will be replaced by media of a known shape. ## When not to use - Fixed-size icons or avatars; give them a size and be done. - Text blocks. A ratio box around text clips exactly the content that needs to grow. - A container whose height should follow its content — that is a normal block. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/aspect-ratio ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { AspectRatio } from "@/components/cadence/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio"; export function Cover() { return ( ); } ``` ## Examples ### Square ```tsx ``` ### Video ```tsx
